rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room to Dun Liu
rooms.desc:
Type 'look sign' for the Fortress Map
Type 'look poster' for the Terrain Map

rooms.name: The Throne Room
rooms.desc:
You stand among the nobles and knights of Dun Liu. Servants hurry by you 
and nobody pays much attention to you. Against the back wall stands a huge 
throne, made plush and comfortable for the King's oversized arse. Fron here
you can watch the bribes and blackmail merge all over the world. The only
exit is to the north.

rooms.name: The Ante Chamber
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the Ante Chamber. It's just another word for waiting
room, but everyone who wants to see the King must pass through it. Servants
scuttle by you in their rush to serve the King and the nobles about you. As
you walk around you notice all the expensive tapestries and artwork hanging
and begin to wonder if the King is spending the people's money on himself
instead of his people. What appears to be the throne room lies to the south,
while a great deal of noise comes from the north.

rooms.name: A Heavily Guarded Room
rooms.desc:
For some reason this room is heavily guarded. The guard rooms were well
guarded, but this room is amazing! Guards stand at their posts in a wall of
weapon-wielding maniacs. How insecure could a King be to have so much defense
within the walls of his own fortress? There are exits to the east, west, and
south.

rooms.name: The Royal Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is just another lavishly decorated room, built and decorated by the
King to make him feel more 'at home' in the lands of Dun Liu. You notice many
fine pieces of art and jewelry here. Sculptures stand tall against the walls
while expensive paintings hang behind them. It's begging to look more like an
art gallery than a castle. The Royal Hallway continues east and south.

rooms.desc:
This is one of the many guard rooms of Dun Liu, instituted by the paranoid
King to make sure no assassins could sneak in and kill him. As you walk past
the guards, one of them notices your weapons and calls his comrades to arms.
The are exits south, west, and east with the sound of rattling armor coming
from all of them.

rooms.name: The Outer Hall
rooms.desc:
As you walk down this hallway you note the elaborate textures and designs
hanging on the wall here. As you stroll by the various works of art you
admire the colors and general appearance of the finely carpeted and furnished
hallway. Aside from the occasional angry guard, this is a beautiful place.
There is a guard post to the east, while the outer hall continues west.

The are exits north, west, and east with the sound of rattling armor coming

rooms.name: On the drawbridge
rooms.desc: You stand on a great drawbridge crossing over the moat of Dun Liu.

rooms.name: The Gatehouse
rooms.desc:
You are at the gatehouse to Dun Liu. Stretching to the south are the tall
walls of Dun Liu. The drawbridge is usually down and today is no different.
The orange brick road lies to the north.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People hustle and 
bustle around you as you walk by. A humungous building spans to the north-
east, while the gatehouse lies just south of here, the King has only one 
guard stand watch, a tall man in shiny black armor. The orange brick road
continues north.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People hustle and 
bustle around you as you walk by. There is an incredibly tall building to
the north-east and a gatehouse is just a few paces to the south now, the
entrance to the great castle Dun Liu. The orange brick road continues north
and south.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People hustle and 
bustle around you as you walk by. As you walk you can see the castle itself
growing larger in the horizon to the south. A deep forest grows to the north-
east, and Gandalf's Spells and Sorcery, Ltd stands before you to the east.
The orange brick road continues north and south.

rooms.name: A strange laboratory
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a odd-looking room. Across from you sits an odd-
looking man in an odd-looking chair with an odd look on his face. Perhaps
something odd is going on here... Apparently the only exit is back down the
staircase.

rooms.name: Scrolls and Sorcery, Ltd.
rooms.desc:
You have wandered into the best magic store this side of Kir Drax'in! Gandalf
stands at a counter, greedily counting his profits and grinning at you in a
way that sends a chill down your spine. As you walk about the store you
notice loads of staves, scrolls, and other little trinkets with plump price 
tags. Just in case you run out of money, there is an ATM mounted on the wall
next to the counter. The only exit is back out onto the Orange Brick Road.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. Shops and cafes line 
the street all around you, and an especially large building stands to the 
south-east, with the letters S&S Ltd on the side, while the fortress grows
larger to the south. A peculiar dirt road stretches off the the east and the
orange brick road continues to the west and south.

rooms.name: A dirt road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a dark, winding road. The roadside is filled with
dark, ominous trees and sounds of feirce animals. There is a dark, densly
forested area somewhere off to the north. The dirt road continues east,
while the orange brick road lies to the west.

rooms.name: The Orange Brick Road
rooms.desc:
You are on an interesting orange-colored brick road. People bustle and
bustle around you as you walk by. Stretching high over the buildings you 
can see a mighty castle to the south-east. Just down the road to the east
a forest of tall oaks and pines reaches into the horizon. The city gate is
to the west.

rooms.name: A dirt road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a dark, winding road. The roadside is filled with
dark, ominous trees and sounds of feirce animals. A large, eerie thicket
lies far ahead to the north, while Dun Liu lies just to the west. The dirt
road continues north and west.

rooms.name: The King's Bedchamber
rooms.desc:
Here is where thte King E'douird spends his long nights. As you look around
you notice that it is very defendable and has guards walk by regularly. In 
fact, it sounds like the guards now are coming now...

rooms.name: A dirt road
rooms.desc:
You are walking along a dark, winding road. The roadside is filled with
dark, ominous trees and sounds of feirce animals. There is a strange thicket
to the north, growing creepier and scarier. The dirt road continues south
and west.

rooms.name: A winding staircase
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a dark, dank staircase. As you climb up step by step
all you can see is a tiny light comming from the top. All sorts of insects
pass you on their way to forage for food. As you climb you dodge various
spider webs and disgusting little insect nests that would make any other
person vomit uncontrollably. Whoever is at the top must have a strong stomach.

rooms.desc:

You have entered a slimy passage. There is some sort of ooze covering the
walls, the floor, EVERYTHING. The air is dark and damp and everywhere seems
to lead nowhere. There are exits to the west and south.

rooms.name: A dark thicket
rooms.desc:
You are in a very dark thicket. All around you different trees and plants
sprout up, making everything feel like it's closing in on you. Strange noises
come from deeper into the thicket, made by some tortured animal... There
appears to be no way out of this hellish place, all the paths look the same!

rooms.name: A slimy passage
rooms.desc:
You have entered a slimy passage. There is some sort of ooze covering the
walls, the floor, EVERYTHING. The air is dark and damp and everywhere seems
to lead nowhere. There is an exit to the north and another tunnel leading
down.

rooms.name: A dark thicket
rooms.desc:
You are in a very dark thicket. All around you different trees and plants
sprout up, making everything feel like it's closing in on you. Strange noises
come from deeper into the thicket, made by some tortured animal... There
appears to be no way out of this hellish place, all the paths look the same!

rooms.name: A dark crevice
rooms.desc:
You have entered a deep, dark crevice. There is an eerie lack of light
here, destroyed the instant you enter. Apparently there is little or no life
down here... as if anything could actually be disgusting enough to survive
down here anyway. The tunnel continues below you and it empties into a
passage above you.

rooms.name: A back room
rooms.desc:
You stand amid piles and piles of miscellaneous junk. Scrolls, potions,
staves, wands, anything you can imagine. There is a door on the west wall,
leading back into some shop, if you could only figure out how to use it...
There is a door to the west and east.

rooms.name: A slimy passage
rooms.desc:
You have entered a deep, dark crevice. There is an eerie lack of light
here, destroyed the instant you enter. Apparently there is little or no life
down here... as if anything could actually be disgusting enough to survive
down here anyway. The tunnel continues above and below you.

rooms.name: A dark thicket
rooms.desc:
You are in a very dark thicket. All around you different trees and plants
sprout up, making everything feel like it's closing in on you. Strange noises
come from deeper into the thicket, made by some tortured animal... There
appears to be no way out of this hellish place, all the paths look the same!

rooms.name: A dark crevice
rooms.desc:
The dark crevice ends abruptly here. There is a horrible stench, much
worse than any other smell in all of the tunnels. There is an eerie lack
of scum and rats in this room, making in very quiet... too quiet.

rooms.name: The Cheese Chamber
rooms.desc:
Welcome to the Cheese Chamber.  Here lies the various tasks Phondew set
out to complete but never has, including this area!  You notice packages
of cheese strewn about without any order in this room of chaos.  An orange
couch lies in a corner and there is a area of the room devoted to worshipping
the Sacred Cow, whom resides in the very room at all times looking to convert
others to the Way Of The Cow.
